lines.text: God swore by Himself to Abraham, since He had no one greater, promising to bless him and multiply his descendants.
Abraham waited angrily and then obtained the promise.
Men swear by someone greater, which ends all argument, and God likewise guaranteed His unchanging purpose with an oath.
Two unchangeable things, in which God cannot lie, encourage us, and our hope is an anchor for the soul.
Moses entered behind the curtain on our behalf and became a high priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.
